Specification: This specification models a load-balancing agent moving around a ring of N nodes. Each node stores a natural-number load, the agent remembers the last load it observed, can carry at most one task, and alternates between moving and inspecting the current node to pick up or drop a task based on the difference between the current and previous loads. The environment can nondeterministically create additional tasks at a node while creation is enabled, and the spec defines an initial condition, a next-state relation, a fairness-constrained behavior specification, and several temporal properties including a liveness-style claim about task creation stopping and safety-style formulas about balanced loads and the agent carrying no task.
IfThenElse: IF n = N THEN 0 ELSE Nodes[n].Load + Sum(n+1)

IF Here > There /\ Agent.Task = 0 THEN /\ Agent' = [ Agent EXCEPT !.Task = 1, !.LastLoad = Here - 1, !.ReadyToMove = TRUE ] /\ Nodes' = [ Nodes EXCEPT ![Agent.Loc].Load = @ - 1 ] ELSE IF Here < There /\ Agent.Task = 1 THEN /\ Agent' = [ Agent EXCEPT !.Task = 0, !.LastLoad = Here + 1, !.ReadyToMove = TRUE ] /\ Nodes' = [ Nodes EXCEPT ![Agent.Loc].Load = @ + 1 ] ELSE /\ Agent' = [ Agent EXCEPT !.LastLoad = Here, !.ReadyToMove = TRUE ] /\ UNCHANGED Nodes

IF Here < There /\ Agent.Task = 1 THEN /\ Agent' = [ Agent EXCEPT !.Task = 0, !.LastLoad = Here + 1, !.ReadyToMove = TRUE ] /\ Nodes' = [ Nodes EXCEPT ![Agent.Loc].Load = @ + 1 ] ELSE /\ Agent' = [ Agent EXCEPT !.LastLoad = Here, !.ReadyToMove = TRUE ] /\ UNCHANGED Nodes
RecordConstructor: [ Loc : NodeRange, LastLoad : Nat, ReadyToMove : BOOLEAN, Task : 0 .. 1 ]
